illustrations.title: A rough standing stone drawn in a woodblock style resting atop a blue horizon made of complex swooshing lines. A design is carved into the rock. This petroglyph is a vertical rectangle with three horizontal lines across it, and above this rectangle is an angular symbol that might be a flame. Above the rock is one slashed line with notches at the end that look like the calligraphic terminal flourishes of a reed pen.
A full-color illustration. A white man with shoulder-length black hair who

A rhombus-shaped standing stone atop the same intricate blue horizon from the previous chapter. The petroglyph on this rock is a triangle with a set of lines attached to it that almost look like a minimalist tree. Above the rock are two calligraphic slashes. A sun begins to rise from beneath the horizon.
An old man glowers and looms forward, and he hovers against a backdrop of stars. He has long hair, a long beard, and bushy white eyebrows. He holds out his hand to control a host of hovering planets.
A stack of precariously balanced stones with a humanoid stick figure petroglyph. Above the rock are three slashes, and the sun rises higher over the horizon.

A small cartoon starring a squashy marshmallow character dressed in a blue robe and pointed wizard hat. This wizard, named Mervin, drives a go-cart seemingly built from an hourglass, a clock, some wheels, and a pair of antennae. The go-cart sits in a prehistoric paradise complete with a T-rex, a Pteranodon, a triceratops, and other lizards with overly large eyes and cute bellies.
A rectangular stone slab with a round boulder stacked on top. There is a triangular petroglyph carved in the boulder. Above are four slashes, and the sun rises higher over the horizon.

A roughly triangular stone slab stands among a handful of smaller stones. On the slab is a petroglyph of a human that has fallen on its head. Above are five slashes, and the sun pulls free of the horizon to rise higher.

A wide rectangular stone. Its petroglyph depicts what might be a triangular bowl or a brazier between two tall pillars topped with lightning bolt motifs. Above are six slashes, and the sun rises higher.

A tall slab of stone bears a petroglyph that looks a little like angular feet with more lightning motifs. Or possibly stink lines. Who can say, with petroglyphs? Above are seven slashes, and the sun rises higher.
A tower of tiny stones supports a very large rock that has petroglyph of a long, skinny rectangle arranged horizontally over three horizontal lines. Above are eight slashes, and the sun rises higher.

Mervin stands, starry-eyed and giddy, in front of a triptych of fantastical situations. In the left panel, a serpentine dragon with fire and smoke in its jaws faces off against a beefy male barbarian who

A small stack of tiny stones supports an inverted triangle rock. Its petroglyph is a collection of angular shapes that together look almost like a wizard hat over a bearded face. Above are nine slashes, and the sun rises higher.

Two narrow stones support an irregular rock bearing a petroglyph of a horse. Above are ten slashes, and the sun rises higher.

Two narrow stones of different sizes stand next to each other. The larger one has a petroglyph of a human wearing a pointed hat. The petroglyph human carries a blank rectangle and a simple line in its hands. The smaller stone is blank. Above are eleven slashes, and the sun rises higher.

A long, coffin-shaped stone leans against a pile of smaller rocks. On the large stone is an axe-shaped petroglyph. Above are twelve slashes, and the sun rises higher.
Mervin is quite grumpy and stands, with arms crossed, amid a collection of rabid bananas with fierce, distressingly toothy snarls on their faces. The angry bananas hold picket signs that say

A bell curve set in the positive-values quadrant of a graph. The y-axis says ‘Likelihood of a dimension existing’ and points upward. The x-axis label is centered under the tallest part of the bell curve and says ‘percentage different from our own dimension.’ Arrows for the x-axis values point in both directions away from the center of the bell curve. There are no number labels, and the graph clumsily conveys that dimensions that are very similar to or very different from our dimension have a low likelihood of existing and the bulk of the dimensions are only somewhat similar.
Three stones stand in a row. The center stone, the largest, bears a petroglyph of a ship sailing on water. The smaller stones are blank. Above are thirteen slashes, and the sun rises higher.

Runian and Sefawynn are soaking wet and stand in waist-deep water. Behind them, several Hordamen warriors in heavy armor stand in the shallows in front of their wooden ship, which is being consumed in a raging conflagration of flame. In response to Sefawynn

The architectural offspring of a nuclear power plant and a medieval castle, and someone has stuck an enormous skeletal skull sculpture between the power plant towers. Cannon barrels peek over the top of every wall. Before the castle is a sleek helicopter with too many firearm barrels jutting out from its body, and in front of that are a few militant androids and ranks of humans wearing futuristically minimalist armor and opaque visors.
Two narrow rectangular slabs of stone stand next to each other. Both have angular petroglyph lines carved into them that, to a modern, English-speaking viewer might say

Mervin wears swim trunks and arm floaties with a tank top and his signature wizard hat. He leads a pointy-hat-wearing rubber duck on a leash. Our wizard is quite perturbed. And no wonder! His beach is overrun with elderly wizards with long beards, a giant crab playing beach volleyball, a humongous sand-ringed mouth labeled

A jagged stone that is shorter on the left than the right. The larger side bears two petroglyphs, one that is four triangles tightly stacked on top of each other, three of them vertically and one nestled into the gap left by the other three. A separate, larger triangle is inverted and topped with regular vertical lines. The lines look almost like the crenellations of a medieval castle wall. Above are sixteen slashes, and the sun rises higher.

A collection of oddly shaped stones formed together in a sort of archway. The keystone of the arch is absurdly large and has a petroglyph made of two downward-pointing triangles stacked on top of each other, with the point of the top triangle overlapping the lower one a bit. The top triangle has a crown of five vertical lines piercing it. Above are seventeen slashes, and the sun nears its zenith.

Mervin lounges in a giant treasure chest full of coins. He wears a crown ornately adorned with jewels and a long, fine chain around his neck. The crown is too big for him and slips over one of his eyes. The treasure chest sits in a sea of coins. Nearby, a small dragon gloomily looks at a book that

A smallish stone balances atop the pointy tip of a much larger, somewhat smooth stone. The smallish stone bears a petroglyph that might be a foot with shoelaces on it. Above are eighteen slashes, and the sun is even closer to its zenith.

A low wall of pebbles supports a larger stone bearing a complex petroglyph made of three tiny ships above a mountain-shaped triangle that is framed by several lines at right angles to one another. These right-angle lines almost form rectangles, but have the sides closest to the edge of the stone left open. Above are nineteen slashes, and the sun is at its zenith.
Mervin has his eyeglasses on, trying to read a book called
An inverted triangle stone with a petroglyph of a sword or dagger. Above are twenty slashes, and the sun tilts past its zenith.

A precarious arch of stones. The large keystone has a petroglyph that looks like one of those ancient phones that plugged into the wall. Above are twenty-one slashes, and the sun sinks lower in the sky.

Two long stones lean against each other. The stone on the left has three plus signs or stars and two lines that lead horizontally to the stone on the right. The stone on the right has another plus sign hovering above a square that

Part Two Marginalia. Mervin pops out of the portal. He immediately lands in a crowd of fleeing people. The people have long legs fully extended for the run, bulging, terrified eyes, and at least one babe in arms. The dust they kick up as they flee comes up to Mervin

Mervin stands atop a mountain looking down at a tree-filled area that has a winding river that leads to the sea. Beside the sea is a stone castle with a tower at each of its four corners. Later, Mervin stands near a bathtub and brushes his teeth. No need for poor hygiene just because it

Mervin sails through the air using a bundle of balloons and a fan he has mounted on his back. Mervin rides a giant tortoise that has flames painted on its shell. Mervin plays a lute beside an octopus that is rocking an electric guitar. In an elaborate collection of sketches, a Viking ship sails on the surface of the ocean, troubled by the twisty tentacles of a creature with far too many terrifying teeth to be a proper cephalopod. The Loch Ness Monster waves a flipper at Mervin, who wears scuba gear. Below them, a shark and a squid exchange grumpy glances, and a manatee and a mermaid swim-dance together. Still lower in the ocean is a fish that has a single giant eyeball and no mouth and a sleeping Cthulhu monster with clawed hands and a face dripping tentacles. A sea dragon dreams near a treasure chest, and a crab and an angler fish explore a sunken lifeboat. Overwhelmed by the weight of so many myths and stories, Mervin zonks out atop a bed of open books.

Refreshed from his nap, Mervin approaches a book on a plinth. The book has a fang-filled face on the cover and seems to be dozing. One of its eyes is covered by a length of metal that holds the book closed and is secured with a padlock. The padlock is also threaded through a long metal chain. The Necronomicon book wakes up and yanks against its chain to open a too-wide mouth and stretch its bookmark-ribbon tongue toward Mervin. Mervin startles. Later, Mervin smears some apple spread on a piece of bread. Mervin presents an open picnic basket to the Necronomicon, who examines the basket with its one eye. The Necronomicon dives into the basket and sprays crumbs everywhere. Then Nommy the book peeks out of the basket, which is now in tatters. Mervin holds up a pair of wire cutters as tall as he is. The chain is cut, and Nommy expels cartoon hearts of gratitude. Mervin and Nommy read a storybook together.

Mervin looks up at a large tavern made of stone walls and a thatched roof. Inside the tavern, Mervin helps himself to a foamy drink and keeps his healing potion nearby. Three adventurers sporting impractically large beards enter the tavern. One of them triumphantly holds aloft a scaly egg that’s as big as Mervin. He holds the egg forward while one of his companions demands fried eggs. The three adventurers sit at the tavern bar while the tavern chef walks off with the egg. But Mervin hears the egg tunefully chirping, and he

Mervin flees, the singing egg in his arms, from a well-armed chef and three hungry adventurers. Mervin hides behind a large tree trunk, keeping the egg hidden with him. Back at the tavern, the chef finds Mervin

An ancient male wizard sits on a wide throne and wears a pointy hat decorated with metal horns. His throne is on a dais at the top of a flight of twelve steps, and his beard is so long that it tumbles down all of them. Skeletons litter the steps, and artificially happy androids dote upon the wizard at his throne.
An smoothed oval stone. Its petroglyph is some sort of tall structure with gusts of wind passing around it. Above are twenty-three slashes, and the sun sinks lower.
A collection of cleanly chiseled slabs of stone. The large one in the middle bears three widely spaced-out triangle petroglyphs. Above are twenty-four slashes, and the sun sinks lower.
Squashy wizard winces at its insensitivity. Behind it are four large bananas clamped in shackles. The shackle on the banana farthest to the left says,
A rectangular rock wall supports of perfect sphere of stone. On the sphere is a petroglyph of a pine tree surrounded by short vertical lines. Above are twenty-five slashes, and the sun sinks lower.

Several small spheres of stone support a much larger stone sphere, which bears a complex petroglyph made up of four small triangles, a lightning motif, a square, and a collection of radial lines. Above are twenty-six slashes, and the sun sinks lower.
Mervin peeks out from behind a blindfold to read a very long scroll. Behind him are the scales of justice and many stacks of books.

Two roughly round stones sit atop a low rock wall. The bigger stone on the left has a large rhombus-shaped petroglyph with a cross through its middle, and there are two lines pointing to the smaller stone on the right. The smaller stone
A small stone sphere supports a large hemisphere of rock. On the hemisphere is a petroglyph of three pine trees and several pairs of dots. Above are twenty-eight slashes, and the sun sinks lower.

A woman in a massive mecha suit raises her mecha’s arm to cheer a horde of soldiers in mail armor. Among the soldiers is a woman astride an armored horse. She raises a banner above the army and shouts a battle cry.

A thin pebble supports a wide oval stone. The oval’s petroglyph, to a modern eye, might look like a fire. Above the probably-not-a-fire are two spears piercing squares. One of the squares almost looks like it

A tiny column of pebbles supports a large irregular rock. The large rock has a petroglyph with a human riding a fancy horse. Diagonally down and to the right from the horse, two more humans are on foot and holding hands. Above are thirty slashes, and the sun sinks lower.

Part Three Marginalia. The tavern town has been torched, presumably by the dragon from the last illustration. The dragon even attacks the road where Mervin is, and Mervin flees from a wall of flame. The townsfolk approach the top-heavy hero with his loins girded in beard and beg him for help. Top-Heavy Hero starts off on his quest, but Mervin grips the man’s hand and tries to haul the hero to a stop. Mervin points back at the comfy egg in his wagon. Mervin won’t stop shouting about the egg, but Top-Heavy Hero doesn

Top-Heavy Hero gets properly angry. His expression has chasm-like wrinkles of rage, and he spouts poisonous rhetoric of death. As Top-Heavy Hero marches to kill the dragon, Mervin heaves on the beard-cloth. But Mervin doesn’t have the heft to stop this murder machine, so he and the egg-filled wagon are dragged along by Top-Heavy Hero’s heedless determination. Behind him, the adventurers and the chef hide behind a low brick wall and plot. Top-Heavy Hero climbs a cliff face, pulling Mervin and the egg up with him. Above the hero, a round mountain sheep watches the amateur attempt, and below the hero, the adventurers and the chef watch their meal get away. Later, a hand emerges from a pool of water holding a sword. Then a woman with long, flowing hair holds the sword, its blade across both her palms, and bows her head.

The Lady of the Lake holds the sword toward Top-Heavy Hero. He looks back at Mervin, who is losing his gosh-dang mind. Mervin has hearts instead of eyeballs and shouts some nonsense about a sword stuck in an anvil. Top-Heavy Hero takes no notice and tosses the sword away, startling the Lady of the Lake and forcing Mervin to duck behind his hat to avoid getting hit. Top-Heavy Hero crouches to whisper in the Lady of the Lake
Mervin struggles up the mountain alone, hauling the swaddled egg in the wagon behind him. Mervin approaches a door plastered with signs that say

The dragon snaps her jaws onto Mervin, even taking some shreds out of his hat. Before she swallows, the dragon notices her shining, pristinely protected egg. She spits Mervin out and begins administering chest compressions. He remains unresponsive, and she pulls out her automated external defibrillator.

The dragon gently breathes some fire on her egg. The egg hatches! Unlike its mother, the hatchling is not long and serpentine, but pudgy and egg-shaped. It has very round eyes and teeny wings much too small for its body. The dragon and her hatchling weep over Mervin

Mervin cowers in a cave before a monster that is a cross between a toilet, a spider, and a shark. The toilet has far too many spindly legs, and the lid and bowl are ringed with razor-sharp teeth. The toilet bowl is home to a slithery tongue that grasps toward Mervin. In the background, cocoons holding toilet-spider prey hang from stalactites.
Two tidy towers of rock hold a circular stone between them. The circular stone bears a large X petroglyph that

A crescent-shaped stack of stones frames a smooth sphere. The sphere has an axe-shaped petroglyph that appears to be in motion against some arrows or spears. Above are thirty-two slashes, and the sun sinks lower.

A tower of flat stones supports a wide pentagon-shaped rock. It bears a complex petroglyph that might be rolling storm clouds, lightning, and darts or arrows. Above are thirty-three slashes, and the sun sinks lower.

A rock column supports a rugged sphere of stone. The sphere has a rhombus petroglyph with a cross inside it. The rhombus is surrounded by radial lines. Above are thirty-four slashes, and the sun is almost to the horizon.

A large sphere of stone supports masoned stones set in a fan-like design. The fan has the complex storm cloud petroglyph from earlier, and the sphere has a human petroglyph peeking out from behind tall vertical lines. Above are thirty-five slashes, and the sun kisses the horizon.

Sefawynn stands atop a rock, her fist raised to the sky. Her skirts tumble around her legs in the wind, and her tangled golden hair flares around her face, which is contorted in an expression of defiant rage. Behind her, among a mass of ominous clouds, a lighting bolt strikes. The lightning illuminates her and lights her fierce eyes, and a fire begins to burn in her wake.

Two triangular stones support a rock sphere. On the sphere, a human petroglyph stands in a strong stance and is braced by a cross within its chest area. Above are thirty-six slashes, and the sun sets lower.

Ealstan slumps against a stone wall, barely staying on his feet. His jaw is clenched in a determined expression. He cradles a rectangular-shaped firearm and a severed human arm. The severed arm is dull and gray and has its index finger wrapped around the firearm
In the foreground, a female wizard wears a hood and a set of goggles with multiple lenses. She looks down pensively and rests against her wizard

A rectangular rock pillar rests against a tall oval stone. Each rock bears an inverted triangle petroglyph with a notch at the top. The triangles almost look like heart shapes. The triangles are connected by horizontal lines. Above are thirty-seven slashes, and the sun is almost fully set.

Logna squats on a wooden pier. She is thin, wiry, and wrinkly, and although much of her grey-and-brown hair is tied in a tail at the nape of her neck, a fair amount flies wildly from her scalp. She smirks down at Runian, who sits in shallow water and glares up at her with his arms crossed in front of him. Behind them, the sun rises over a lush green forest.
Part Four Marginalia. The happy hatchling tackles Mervin, who is also happy he is not dead. The doorway to the dragon
The dragon soars through the air. Her hatchling floats near her head, and Mervin perches on her skull above her eyes. The Lady of the Lake sits astride the dragon

Everyone pitches in. Top-Heavy Hero hauls planed wooden boards. One skeleton uses a wheelbarrow to transport bricks. The chef uses mortar to make a tidy brick wall, and one of the adventurers hammers a bit of metal at an anvil. Two skeletons hold up a wooden wall frame, which Mervin inspects. The dragon carries the lumber frame for a roof. Later, they have a barbecue. The dragon heats the grill, which the chef oversees. Mervin waves a bubble wand and the hatchling floats among the bubbles. The three adventurers play chess, and the Lady of the Lake does a plein air painting of Top-Heavy Hero, who lounges against a tree and reads a large book. At the end, Mervin waves to you, the reader. Epilogue

A large rectangular stone wall. Its petroglyph is a rectangular frame that contains three humanoid figures, two larger and one smaller and wearing a crown. All three figures seem suspended by long vertical lines. To the side of the frame, two hand-shaped petroglyphs gesture toward the humans. Barely a sliver of the sun shows above the horizon.
